data.body: Ticket 6 TDD held-out loop: wrote 3 new RED tests (decide.py no-severity, normalize_finding absent-stays-absent, shim.py present-value-passthrough) plus fixed 3 now-stale existing assertions (test_divergence_grade_split.py x2, test_plan_review.py x1 -- these asserted pass3_decide's output carried severity, which is deliberately being retired; fixed under revert-first discipline) and replaced 1 obsolete parametrized test (test_shim_maps_kernel_severity_to_common_vocabulary, which tested the _KERNEL_TO_COMMON_SEVERITY map being deleted) with 2 new tests. Held out the full-chain integration test (shim -> finalize_findings -> normalize_finding -> final review_result has no severity key) -- the exact composition defect the plan-review gate caught -- physically removed from test_code_review_ws4.py, saved to /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/jobs/f3367052/tmp/heldout/test_code_review_ws4_FULL.py. Made the schema relaxation edit myself (common.schema.json: severity removed from finding.required, property/enum kept). Dispatched implementer subagent for decide.py, shim.py, findings.py, config.py cleanup (SEVERITIES/DEFAULT_BLOCKING_SEVERITIES/blocking_severities/_severities_env removal), and the two review_bot test file updates. Now drafting the ADR amendment + release-notes/CHANGELOG compatibility-note entries myself (docs work).
